sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Offshore Trade Intermediary and Commercial Re-Invoicing Operations

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PACER Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus) — trade facilitation in goods and services
Melanesian Spearhead Group Trade Agreement — regional trade and investment facilitation
No comprehensive Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement (DTAA) network; Vanuatu applies a zero-tax regime under the International Companies Act

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act, Chapter 222 (Vanuatu), as amended; Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 16 of 2016, as amended; Beneficial Ownership and AML/CFT Regulations 2021; Financial Services Commission Act; VFSC Guidance Notes and Enforcement Guidelines.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the passport of each proposed shareholder, director, and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public or authorized bank in the document origin country

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement dated within last 3 months)
Bank reference letter / professional reference covering commercial probity and source of funds
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Lending institution or corporate bank in the UBO's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: For corporate shareholders: certified corporate extract, certificate of good standing, and register of directors/UBOs
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Originating company registry in the shareholder's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association (executed in notarial form)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Vanuatu notary public / corporate legal counsel

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against the UN Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU/UK consolidated financial sanctions lists, and Vanuatu domestic AML/CFT directives under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 16 of 2016. Enhanced due diligence (EDD) is required for politically exposed persons (PEPs), high-risk non-resident beneficial owners, and jurisdictions listed by FATF. Verification must include government-issued photo ID, source of wealth, source of funds for re-invoicing trade, and ongoing monitoring of all SWIFT/TT/XT payment rails. Records must be retained for at least five years after business relationship termination.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Companies Registry Online Portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The official company name of an International Company must be expressed in Latin script (A–Z, a–z, 0–9, hyphen, plus sign, comma, full stop, apostrophe and ampersand). Non-Latin characters (Chinese, Cyrillic, Arabic, Hebrew) are prohibited; a romanized transliteration is mandatory. English and French names are accepted, and Bislama names may be used if they are not misleading. The name must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered name and must not imply any connection with government or an activity requiring a license.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank, Banking, Credit Union, Loan Company
Government, Crown, National, Ministry, Presidential, Sovereign
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If VFSC rejects the proposed name, the applicant receives a formal refusal notice stating the statutory basis. Within 14 calendar days after receipt, the applicant may submit a written appeal to the VFSC Companies Registry containing the reservation reference number, a statement of grounds, the proposed name, and any supporting arguments or evidence. VFSC will provide a written determination within 10 business days. A further administrative review may be filed with the Registrar of Companies under the International Companies Act, Chapter 222, if the initial appeal is unsuccessful.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office address is permissible for preliminary correspondence only. After incorporation, the International Company must contract with a VFSC-licensed registered agent in Vanuatu that supplies a physical registered office in Port Vila or Luganville. A mail-forwarding-only virtual office is not sufficient because the registered agent must maintain the statutory registered office and appoint the company's governing body. The actual trading operations for a re-invoicing hub may be conducted outside Vanuatu provided the registered agent and local registered office are maintained.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk of unannounced physical on-site inspections is low (<5%) for a standard single-purpose International Company that does not hold a VFSC license and does not maintain a loan/insurance portfolio. The risk rises to approximately 20–30% if the company becomes a banking counterparty, holds real estate in Vanuatu, or receives adverse intelligence from the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC name clearance and reservation fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee in accordance with the International Companies Act and VFSC Fee Schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC incorporation filing fee for International Company
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: VFSC Fee Schedule / statutory incorporation tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed registered agent service fee (first year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark; no statutory tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and apostille bundle (passports, proofs, bank references, resolutions)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notarial tariff and per-document apostille fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO compliance / KYC and enhanced due diligence drafting fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark under AML/CFT legal obligations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP, OFAC, UN, and domestic sanctions screening
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Corporate service provider / compliance technology vendor

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Courier, translation, certified corporate extract, and disbursements

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap 222] (ICA), as amended, Sections 5 (incorporation), 6 (certificate), 7 (memorandum and articles), 12 (registered office), 13 (registered agent), and 15 (directors)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Registry, Port Vila, Vanuatu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation of an International Company (VFSC Form IC-01) with attached Memorandum and Articles of Association; issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital. Capital may be expressed in any currency and may remain unissued or partly paid. No escrow account or capital verification is required at incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: That the Company be incorporated under the International Companies Act and that the subscriber shares be allotted as provided in the Memorandum and Articles of Association. RESOLVED: That the registered office be established at the licensed agent's address in Port Vila, Vanuatu. RESOLVED: That [Name] and [Name] consent and are appointed first directors, and [Name] is appointed secretary. RESOLVED: That the directors and secretary are authorized to file all documents, pay statutory fees, obtain the certificate of incorporation, and open bank accounts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-licensed Registered Agent under Section 13 of the International Companies Act
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Appoint a VFSC-licensed registered agent to act as the registered office provider and filing representative. The agent will conduct client due diligence and consent to act as registered agent after the application. Execute an engagement agreement and submit all beneficial ownership and identity documentation for AML/CFT clearance.
required_dossiers: Engagement letter with licensed registered agent
Certified passport copy of each shareholder and director
Proof of residential address of shareholders/directors (not older than 3 months)
Corporate KYC documents if a corporate subscriber is used
Bank reference or professional reference letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the agent declines due diligence or queries the documents, rectify the deficient KYC pack and resubmit within 5 business days or engage an alternative VFSC-licensed agent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit two preferred company names in prescribed format ending with 'Limited' or 'Ltd.' for approval. The Registry will check against existing registered names and prohibited names under the ICA. Once approved, the name is reserved for a limited period pending incorporation.
required_dossiers: Name Clearance Application Form
Two proposed company names in order of priority
Consent of the licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a selected name is rejected as undesirable or too similar, promptly submit the alternate reserved name or file a fresh name clearance application with two new proposed names; no additional fee is charged for a single re-submission of a rejected name.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in compliance with Schedule to the International Companies Act, including objects, registered capital, share classes, director provisions, and alternation restrictions. Each subscriber shall execute the documents in the presence of a witness; execution may be done electronically where the agent's platform supports digital signature and verification.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association (draft and executed)
Consent to act as director, secretary, and registered agent
Statement of proposed registered office address
Share subscription forms
Written consent of subscribers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the VFSC queries the constitution for omissions or incompatibility with the ICA, the agent will revise the relevant articles and circulate the amendment for subscriber reprocessing within 7 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Application to VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent electronically or physically lodges VFSC Form IC-01 together with the executed constitution, registered agent consent, director consents, and the prescribed government fee. The application must include a declaration of compliance under ICA Section 5. All duress or notarization requirements are fulfilled before submission.
required_dossiers: VFSC Form IC-01 (Application for Incorporation)
Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consent of directors and secretary
Consent of registered agent to act
Notice of registered office address
Declaration of compliance statement
Government fee payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC issues a query or Query Letter, the registered agent will file a written response with corrected documents within 10 business days. The normal incorporation timeline restarts only after VFSC accepts the cure; repeated non-compliance may require a fresh filing and additional fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of Statutory Fees and Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval of the application, the VFSC debits the registered agent's deposit account or accepts a wire transfer of the official fee. The Commission then registers the company and issues the Certificate of Incorporation under seal, which evidences the company's existence and date of incorporation.
required_dossiers: Confirmed receipt of incorporation fee
Certificate of Incorporation draft (for verification)
Company file reference number assigned by VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate is not issued within the SLA or contains data errors, file a Request for Certificate Amendment with the VFSC Registry accompanied by supporting affidavits; an amended certificate is normally produced within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting in accordance with the ICA and the adopted articles. Maintain the statutory register at the registered office or with the agent, issue share certificates to subscribers, record minutes of the first board resolution, and file any required notice of directors or secretary with the VFSC if required by the agent's practice or the Company's documents.
required_dossiers: Minutes of the first board meeting
Share certificates issued to subscribers
Register of directors and secretary
Register of shareholders
Registered office confirmation letter from the agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a filing of director/secretary details is rejected or queried, the registered agent shall file an amendment notice and provide corrected consents or certified identification within 5 business days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable – the re-invoicing trade intermediary holds no physical manufacturing or industrial establishment; therefore neither Vanuatu Investment Authority (VIPA) nor the Department of Industry issues a mandatory operating license for this scope.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No statutory operating permit or manufacturing license is required for pure commercial re-invoicing and offshore trade intermediation under ISIC 4690.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Energy, Environment and Disaster Risk Reduction
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – Category 5 administrative/trading activity with no land disturbance or emission source; no formal EIA registration is required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable for a pure re-invoicing hub. If a supporting storage or consolidation facility is later established, the operator must comply with the Waste Management Act and Pollution Control Regulations regarding wastewater discharge limits, volatile organic compound (VOC) emissions, and hazardous waste handling thresholds.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not required for pure administrative trade operations. Should a physically occupied office or minimal warehouse be opened, the business must obtain fire safety certification from the Vanuatu Fire Service and a building occupancy/structural load inspection certificate from the Public Works Department, together with registration under the Occupational Health and Safety Act as applicable.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (DCIR), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Government of the Republic of Vanuatu; official portal: https://customs.gov.vu (Vanuatu Revenue and Customs online services)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A non-resident entity must submit a prescribed TIN/VAT registration application together with certificate of incorporation, constitutional documents, registered office address, director and shareholder passport copies, and bank reference letter to the Commissioner of Inland Revenue; TIN certificate is typically issued within 7-14 business days. An International Company (IC) incorporated under the International Companies Act Cap 222 through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) is automatically classified as tax-exempt and requires no income-tax registration; VAT registration is mandatory only when supplying taxable goods or services consumed in Vanuatu. A pure offshore re-invoicing hub supplying only exported goods or offshore services may register voluntarily to zero-rate exports and recover input VAT.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election exists under Vanuatu law; tax-exempt status of an International Company is automatic under the International Companies Act Cap 222 provided the IC does not carry on business in Vanuatu. No elective pass-through regime is available because Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax, capital gains tax, or withholding tax. An IC that commences local business must register as a foreign-investment enterprise and loses exemption for that Vanuatu-source activity; economic substance reporting obligations apply to geographically mobile income but do not create a fiscal election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act [Cap 248]
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 5,000,000 (approximately USD 42,000) annual taxable turnover for resident suppliers; mandatory registration applies when the threshold is exceeded or upon taxable imports; non-resident suppliers of services consumed in Vanuatu are registrable without threshold benefit; voluntary registration is permitted for exporters.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, API-based e-invoicing, or digital stamping mandate is in force in Vanuatu. VAT-registered suppliers must issue a compliant tax invoice (sequential number, supplier TIN, date, description, VAT amount) and retain records for audit; export declarations are processed through the ASYCUDA World electronic single-window system with digital customs records; government e-invoicing reform is at pilot stage and not yet mandatory.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero rating applies to (i) goods physically exported from Vanuatu within 28 days of supply, evidenced by a customs export declaration, and (ii) services supplied for direct use and consumption outside Vanuatu to a non-resident recipient. A re-invoicing hub may zero-rate its trading margin on offshore transactions provided no value is consumed in Vanuatu and the supplier holds valid VAT registration; input VAT is recoverable to the extent attributable to zero-rated supplies. Goods and services consumed in Vanuatu remain taxable at 12.5%.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (SAD approved via ASYCUDA World)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing physical export
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT TT credit advice evidencing foreign currency payment
Insurance certificate and certificate of origin (where applicable)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Commissioner of Inland Revenue may disallow zero rating, claw back input VAT credits, and assess interest at 1.5% per month plus civil penalties up to 200% of evaded VAT where export documentation is deficient or fraudulent (VAT Act Cap 248 ss.70-75); criminal false-declaration offences attract fines up to VUV 1,000,000 per offence and/or imprisonment up to 2 years. Vanuatu imposes no statutory FX repatriation deadline, so the 180-day figure is a prudent compliance benchmark; inward remittance evidence is nevertheless used by banks and the Financial Intelligence Unit for AML verification of export proceeds.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), constituted under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [Cap. 125], is the exclusive monetary authority with statutory powers over Vatu (VUV) issuance, official exchange-rate fixing, exchange-control administration, Authorized Dealer (AD) bank licensing, and bank supervision. The Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) administers the registration and supervision of the International Company (VU_IC), its registered agent, and its beneficial-ownership filings; cross-border banking flows affecting the entity fall under the joint oversight of RBV and the national AML/CFT supervision framework administered with the VFSC.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vatu is fully convertible for both current-account and capital-account transactions. Vanuatu maintains a liberal exchange-control regime: there are no prior approvals, quotas, exchange restrictions, or withholding taxes applied to dividend distributions, profit repatriation, or liquidation proceeds of International Companies. The only practical hurdles are bank-level documentary requirements under the CRS/FATCA disclosure regime and AML/CFT source-of-funds verification, which require board resolutions, profit-support schedules, and executed trade contracts. The VUV exchange rate is a managed basket float against USD, AUD, NZD, EUR, and JPY, fixed daily by the RBV; no meaningful offshore VUV market exists, so USD-denominated clearing is commercially essential for re-invoicing operations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu imposes no statutory export-proceeds surrender obligation and no mandatory conversion ratio. The VU_IC may retain re-invoicing and trading receipts in foreign currency indefinitely within AD-bank Foreign Currency Accounts or external approved accounts. In practice, AD banks enforce an internally prescribed 90-to-180 day document-matching rule: each incoming trade receipt must be reconciled to a signed contract and commercial invoice within that window, otherwise the funds may be frozen pending an AML investigation. This de facto compliance timeline governs the re-invoicing treasury calendar.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) Vanuatu Limited

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium-High feasibility strictly as a supplementary settlement utility; offshore EMIs (X-Transfer, Airwallex, Currencycloud) are legally permissible for collecting and disbursing small-ticket trade payments through partner banks in Hong Kong, the United States, or Singapore. Legal constraints: (i) offshore EMIs are not licensed by the RBV and cannot clear or hold VUV; (ii) EMIs independently classify the re-invoicing model as Medium_Risk_Enhanced and mirror AD-bank trade-file requirements; (iii) EMI rails must not be used for counterparties in high-risk or sanction-adjacent jurisdictions because onward-transfer AML oversight is weaker; (iv) primary liquidity and documentary-letter-of-credit capacity must remain with a Vanuatu-licensed AD bank to evidence regulatory substance.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote onboarding is legally permitted for International Companies, but every Vanuatu AD bank mandates a video-KYC interview with all directors, the company secretary, and the ultimate beneficial owner, with identity documents physically certified by a VFSC-licensed registered agent. ANZ and BSP additionally require an in-person activation meeting in Port Vila for re-invoicing hubs classified as Medium_Risk_Enhanced before the first high-value deposit; NBV and BRED accept fully remote onboarding subject to a written banking reference from the parent company's home bank and a committed source-of-funds declaration. Practical advisory: at least quarterly physical visits to Port Vila by one director materially shorten per-transaction compliance turnaround.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Newly incorporated zero-tax International Company with no historical financial statements and a high-volume re-invoicing mandate.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing; registered-agent compliance letter; 12-month certified business plan; executed master supply and re-sale agreements; substance-services agreement or head lease naming the IC; director and UBO statutory declarations on source of working capital.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Thin-margin mirror flows (buyer receipts promptly matched to supplier disbursements) exhibiting layering or trade-based money-laundering typology.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete transaction file per flow: end-buyer purchase order, supplier proforma invoice, bill of lading or airway bill, certificate of origin, customs declarations, internal margin report, and logistics evidence; written covenant to deliver trailing documentation within five banking days; annual independent audit of the re-invoicing trail.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Fund flows involving counterparties in FATF grey-listed, sanctioned, or high-risk jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Beneficial-ownership extract from the VFSC registry; independent OFAC/EU/UN sanctions screening report; counterparty KYC file containing bank confirmation, license, and negative-news checks; Port Vila legal opinion confirming compliance with the FATF Recommendations and national AML/CFT legislation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Vanuatu's FATF enhanced-monitoring (grey-list) status elevating baseline scrutiny on all Pacific offshore corporate accounts.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bespoke AML/CFT compliance manual aligned with the FATF Recommendations and RBV/AML supervisory directives; appointment of a local Vanuatu AML Compliance Officer; enhanced transaction-monitoring and counterparty-screening workflows; annual external compliance audit certificate from an internationally recognized firm.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital injections must be routed by SWIFT MT103 from the parent or beneficial owner through a bank in an acceptable jurisdiction, using a bank-accepted purpose code such as TRADE/WORKING-CAPITAL with field 70 references /RFB/SHARE-CAP/ or /RFB/LOAN/. Required verification bundle: board resolution approving the injection, updated share-allotment register or executed loan deed, source-of-wealth papers of the funder, and CRS/FATCA self-certification. Because Vanuatu International Companies law imposes no minimum paid-up capital, the full amount is immediately accessible as paid-in surplus for trade disbursements without RBV approval or escrow release conditions.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: (i) SWIFT MT103 wire for supplier payments below USD 250,000, embedding invoice and contract references in field 70 and retaining the complete trade file for five years; (ii) irrevocable at-sight Commercial Letter of Credit (SWIFT MT700) issued by the Vanuatu AD bank for high-value purchases, settled against presentation of documents; (iii) X-Transfer (XT) or approved EMI rails for operational disbursements below USD 50,000 per direction, backed by underlying invoices; (iv) RBV-settled local VUV transfers where the beneficiary bank is in Vanuatu. The IC must maintain a time-stamped trade-file repository reconciling each disbursement to the corresponding purchase order, invoice, customs record, and arrival notice.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore VUV/USD and VUV/AUD spot and short-tenor forwards (up to 6 months) with Vanuatu AD banks, requiring an underlying verified commercial obligation
Offshore USD/VUV Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) cash-settled in USD with internationally licensed counterparty banks
Cross-currency swaps between major trade currencies (USD, EUR, AUD, GBP, JPY) executed offshore for maturities up to 12 months
Natural hedging via segregated multi-currency operating accounts (USD, VUV, AUD, EUR) combined with scheduled early conversion of re-invoicing proceeds

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return and payment of annual fee under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - International Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 calendar days of the anniversary of incorporation; due annually on the incorporation anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty accrues immediately upon expiry of the 30-day window; if the annual return remains outstanding for 3 months after the due date, VFSC may administratively strike off the International Company after notice; struck-off status freezes banking transactions and restoration requires payment of arrears and penalties or fresh incorporation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Confidential beneficial ownership register annual confirmation (registered agent attestation; no public filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed VFSC registered agent; records physically maintained at the registered office in Vanuatu
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: At each annual renewal anniversary and immediately upon any transfer of shares; registered agent must sign off on the accuracy of beneficial ownership records
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-maintenance constitutes a breach of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] and Vanuatu AML/CFT obligations; unrecorded share transfers are ineffective against the company; repeated default justifies registered agent resignation and VFSC enforcement including potential deregistration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Certificate of Good Standing (optional but commonly required by banks and counterparties for re-invoicing hub due diligence)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - International Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Issued on application; refreshed at each annual renewal or upon banking/KYC request
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Not a statutory filing; failure to refresh only delays banking and KYC approvals and may trigger enhanced due diligence by correspondent banks.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None applicable. A Vanuatu International Company is statutorily exempt from mandatory external audit, and no financial statements are required to be filed with VFSC (s.106, International Companies Act [Cap. 222]); shareholders or lenders may contractually elect an audit at any capitalisation level.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS if accounts are voluntarily prepared; no mandatory local GAAP or statutory filing requirement; books may be maintained in any currency, but English-language records must be kept at the registered office.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vanuatu has no public UBO register for International Companies; the licensed registered agent maintains a confidential beneficial ownership record, confirms its accuracy at each annual renewal, and updates it promptly upon any transfer of shares; the company may treat the registered holder as the sole member for all corporate purposes until the transfer is recorded in the register of members.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Copy of Memorandum and Articles of Association

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 450 – 1,200 per annum (VFSC-licensed registered agent, registered office, and government liaison services)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not mandatory by law - voluntary IFRS audit engagement typically USD 3,500 - 8,500 per engagement

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% on taxable profits — International Companies are exempt under section 49 of the Vanuatu International Companies Act [Cap 222]; Vanuatu imposes no general corporate income tax.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: The effective tax rate for international re-invoicing/trading income is permanently 0%. No statutory tax holiday is required because the International Company regime itself is zero-rated. There is no branch profit tax, no capital gains tax, no net worth tax, and no minimum corporate income tax. VAT registration at 12.5% applies only to taxable supplies made in Vanuatu; offshore re-invoicing flows remain outside the VAT net when the supply is properly treated as an offshore transaction.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: N/A — no corporate income tax return form exists in Vanuatu for International Companies. The zero CIT liability is self-executing and does not require a return, election, or assessment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: No corporate income tax return line items are required in Vanuatu for an International Company.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign parent companies should not attach a Vanuatu CIT return to their consolidated tax pack; instead record a statutory nil-tax certificate or accountant's letter based on the International Companies Act exemption.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: No CIT late-filing penalty is applicable because no CIT return is due.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: International Company Annual Return — form prescribed by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), submitted through the licensed VFSC-registered agent.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Must be filed within the statutory window following the anniversary of incorporation, as notified by the registered agent; late filing can result in monetary late fees and strike-off from the International Companies Register.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered company name, ICO registration number, date of incorporation, registered office address, registered agent name, shareholder and director list, and confirmation that the company has not traded with Vanuatu residents except in permitted offshore categories.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The non-resident ultimate shareholder must be identified by legal name, date of birth, nationality, and residential address in the beneficial ownership schedule; passport-level verification may be requested by the registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement confirming that accounting records are maintained at the registered office or another location approved by the registered agent, and confirmation whether an auditor report is required.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors should ensure records are accessible in Vanuatu or through the agent; certify nil local turnover if no Vanuatu-source supplies are made.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts VFSC late fees, registered-agent penalty charges, and the risk of administrative strike-off or deregistration if not cured.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VAT Return — prescribed form filed electronically through the Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue portal, only if the company is registered under the Value Added Tax Act [Cap 244].
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Monthly or quarterly as assigned by the VAT Commissioner.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: VAT returns are due on the prescribed lodgment date, typically the 15th day after the end of the VAT period; a reconciliation is due at the end of the fiscal year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable supplies, zero-rated supplies, exempt supplies, output VAT at 12.5%, recoverable input VAT, and net VAT payable or refundable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A re-invoicing hub that arranges the cross-border sale of goods outside Vanuatu should treat those supplies as outside the scope of Vanuatu VAT; invoice allocation, incoterms, and transport documents must substantiate this treatment.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late VAT filing and late VAT payment penalties are prescribed under the VAT Act, including default penalties and daily surcharges; habitual default can lead to enforcement action, asset seizure, and deregistration of the taxable person.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Economic Substance Declaration — annual filing made through VFSC and the registered agent under Vanuatu economic substance rules introduced in 2020.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filed within the statutory period assigned by VFSC for the accounting reference period; no tax payment accompanies the declaration.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Select the distribution and service centre business category for the general re-invoicing and trade intermediary operations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm that non-resident directors do not dominate the substance narrative; core risk-taking and management decisions must be evidenced by board minutes held in Vanuatu.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical office address, number of full-time employees, operating expenditure, and place where core income-generating activities are performed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Maintain payroll records, lease agreements, utility bills, board minutes, and bank statements showing Vanuatu operational substance before relying on the declaration.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Non-filing or false filing can trigger VFSC civil penalties, criminal prosecution, deregistration, and restrictions on directors.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — no dividend withholding tax is imposed by Vanuatu on distributions paid by an International Company, whether to resident or non-resident shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: As Vanuatu imposes no tax at source on dividends, interest, or royalties, no withholding tax relief mechanism is required for outbound payments. Vanuatu has no comprehensive double tax agreement network of practical relevance for re-invoicing income. If a foreign counterparty nevertheless requests a tax residence certificate, the company must apply in writing through its VFSC-registered agent, furnish a certified copy of the International Company registration, the latest annual return, the beneficial ownership schedule, and a director's declaration. The Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue and VFSC will only evidence residence if the entity is regarded as tax resident; an exempt International Company will typically satisfy formal residency, but the certificate does not create a foreign tax credit where no Vanuatu tax was actually suffered.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Vanuatu statutory withholding tax on royalties and interest paid to non-residents is 0% for International Companies. There is no separate treaty rate because Vanuatu has not enacted a comprehensive double tax agreement covering such payments; royalties, license fees, and loan interest paid by an International Company to overseas related or unrelated parties are exempt from Vanuatu tax.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory transfer-pricing documentation threshold is prescribed in Vanuatu; there is no domestic Master File or Local File obligation. For an ISIC 4690 re-invoicing hub, the prudential documentation threshold is set at VUV 30,000,000 (approximately USD 250,000) of aggregate annual related-party cross-border flow-through transactions; above this threshold, the company should maintain a transfer-pricing policy memorandum, transaction file, comparability analysis, intercompany agreements, and contemporaneous evidence of economic substance.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu economic substance rules apply to tax-resident International Companies carrying on a relevant activity. A general re-invoicing and trade intermediary ordinarily falls within the distribution and service centre business category, requiring: a physical office in Vanuatu, full-time employees engaged in managing the trade, key management decisions taken in Vanuatu, operating expenditure commensurate with the value of the cross-border transactions, and an annual substance declaration filed with VFSC. The company should hold regular board meetings in Vanuatu, keep minutes, maintain bank accounts through which re-invoicing settlements actually flow, and avoid functions performed solely by a foreign service provider.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and Misrepresentation to Tax Authorities
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately filing false customs or VAT declarations, creating backdated invoices to support fraudulent VAT credits, misrepresenting the place of supply of re-invoiced goods, or using the Vanuatu International Company to facilitate foreign tax evasion through round-tripping of funds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal conviction under the VAT Act [Cap 244] or the Penal Code can expose the company to substantial fines, confiscation of goods and bank balances, deregistration, and cancellation of the International Company license. VFSC may also suspend or revoke the registered agent relationship and publish a striking-off notice.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers who knowingly sign false declarations or orchestrate sham invoicing are personally liable in civil damages to the company or creditors and can be prosecuted criminally. The corporate veil will be pierced where the company is used as a mere instrumentality of fraud; sanctions include personal fines, travel bans, director disqualification, and imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Failure to Maintain Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating without a real office in Vanuatu, having no employees, delegating all management to an overseas accountant, failing to hold board meetings in Vanuatu, failing to keep accounting records at the registered office, or filing a nil economic substance declaration while actively conducting high-volume re-invoicing.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Non-compliance with the economic substance regime or the International Companies Act constitutes a regulatory offence; VFSC may impose administrative monetary penalties, require a replacement registered agent, direct corrective filings, and ultimately strike the company from the International Companies Register. Continued default may lead to prosecution and court-imposed fines.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face personal disqualification and monetary sanctions if they intentionally authorise a shell operation; a court may lift the veil where the company is a facade concealing personal dealings, making directors personally liable for third-party debts and unpaid statutory fees.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Money Laundering, Terrorist Financing and Sanctions Evasion
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Routing third-party trade payments through the Vanuatu International Company without genuine underlying goods or services, accepting undisclosed beneficial ownership, transacting with sanctioned or high-risk counterparties, structuring Swift LC / TT Wire / XT Transfer payments to avoid AML detection, or failing to report suspicious transactions to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Violation of Vanuatu anti-money laundering legislation and UN financial sanctions regulations attracts criminal liability, confiscation orders, forfeiture of laundered property, and revocation of the International Company registration. Enhanced AML risk treatment by banks and correspondent institutions can also result in frozen accounts, termination of banking relationships, and regulatory enforcement against the registered agent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Company principals and directors may be prosecuted for money laundering and terrorist financing; personal assets are subject to forfeiture, and directors can be denied cross-border travel, arrested on extradition requests, and sentenced to imprisonment for knowing participation or wilful blindness. Beneficial owners hiding behind the International Company structure are not protected by limited liability in such circumstances.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Misreporting of Related-Party Transactions and Transfer-Pricing Artifacts
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Issuing inflated or deflated re-invoicing margins to related suppliers or customers outside Vanuatu without a written intercompany agreement or substantive support; failure to prepare a contemporaneous functional and risk analysis; ignoring the economic substance evidence required by an overseas taxing authority while retaining full profit in the zero-tax Vanuatu International Company.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Although Vanuatu has no domestic transfer-pricing penalty, the same documentation deficiencies can trigger severe foreign tax penalties in buyer and seller jurisdictions, including disallowance of deductions, deemed dividend treatment, secondary adjustments, and penalty adjustments of 100% to 200%. VFSC can impose record-keeping penalties under the International Companies Act if books are not maintained in Vanuatu.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who cause the Vanuatu International Company to act as a sham conduit may be held liable for assisting in a foreign tax offence; under foreign anti-avoidance rules and Vanuatu general company law, where the entity is found to be a puppet, courts can impose restitution orders on the directors and remove the benefit of limited liability.
